summary: Soto voted Yea on H.R. 6090, incorporating the IHRA definition into education-discrimination enforcement, and in 2017 supported recognizing Jerusalem as Israel's capital. At a 2024 meet-and-greet, activists cited his censure of Tlaib, votes for increased Israel funding, and vote against recognizing Gaza Health Ministry death counts. His October 2025 statement called for a "surge of aid to Palestinians in need" but framed it alongside condemning Hamas and pursuing Israel-Gaza peace negotiations, an Israel-centric framing with limited Palestinian solidarity.
